national_questions.qe: Who was appointed as India’s first Chief Election Commissioner in 1950?
national_questions.qh: 1950 में भारत के पहले मुख्य निर्वाचन आयुक्त के रूप में किसकी नियुक्ति हुई?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Sukumar Sen was appointed in 1950 as India’s first Chief Election Commissioner and oversaw the first general election (1951‑52). 
• Option B is Incorrect because M. N. Kaul served later as CEC (1990‑96). 
• Option C is Incorrect because T. N. Seshan was CEC from 1990‑93. 
• Option D is Incorrect because R. K. Singh never held the post of CEC.

national_questions.qe: Which IT platform was launched by the Defence Minister on Defence Accounts Day to integrate the Indian Army Financial Information System?
national_questions.qh: रक्षा मंत्री ने रक्षा लेखा दिवस पर भारतीय सेना वित्तीय सूचना प्रणाली को एकीकृत करने के लिए कौन सा आईटी प्लेटफ़ॉर्म लॉन्च किया?
oe: SAKSHAM integration with Indian Army Financial Information System
PRISM (Payment Routing and Integrated System Management)
oh: भारतीय सेना वित्तीय सूचना प्रणाली के साथ एकीकरण के लिए SAKSHAM
PRISM (पेमेंट रूटिंग और इंटीग्रेटेड सिस्टम मैनेजमेंट)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because SAKSHAM integration with the Indian Army Financial Information System was announced by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh on Defence Accounts Day.
• Option B is Incorrect because PRISM is a payment routing and integrated system management platform, not the integration tool for the Army's financial system.
• Option C is Incorrect because the revamped National Compilation System is a separate financial data consolidation platform, not the specific integration with the Army.
• Option D is Incorrect because no such Defence Financial Management System was launched in the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Which authority was directed by the Supreme Court to submit a report on barium-based firecrackers by October 15?
national_questions.qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने बारीयम‑आधारित फायरक्रैकर्स पर रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करने के लिए किस प्राधिकरण को 15 अक्टूबर तक निर्देशित किया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Supreme Court bench ordered the Additional Solicitor General to place on record the Central Pollution Control Board’s report on barium‑based firecrackers by 15 October.
• Option A is Incorrect as the Ministry of Environment was not the body specifically directed to submit the report.
• Option C is Incorrect because the National Green Tribunal was not mentioned in the order.
• Option D is Incorrect since the Ministry of Home Affairs was not tasked with the report submission.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry's order was the maximum holding period for sugar stocks limited to 15 days for dealers?
national_questions.qh: कौन से मंत्रालय के आदेश के तहत शुगर स्टॉक की अधिकतम धारण अवधि को 15 दिनों तक सीमित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the order to limit sugar stock holding period to 15 days for dealers was issued by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Food Processing Ministry did not issue this directive.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Agriculture Ministry was not involved in this stock‑holding rule.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Commerce Ministry did not announce the limit.

national_questions.qe: On which railway section was the permissible speed of Vande Bharat Express increased to 100 km/h, enabling it to cross the Chenab and Anji bridges?
national_questions.qh: किस रेलवे सेक्शन में वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस की अधिकतम गति 100 किमी/घंटा बढ़ाकर चेनाब और अंजी पुलों को पार किया गया?
oe: Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link
oh: उधमपुर‑सिन्धुर्ग‑बरामुड़ा रेल लिंक का कत्रा‑बनिहाल सेक्शन
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the speed test was conducted on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising the limit to 100 km/h.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Delhi‑Mumbai corridor was not involved.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Chennai‑Bengaluru line was not part of this test.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Howrah‑Delhi main line was not used for this speed increase.

national_questions.qe: MOI‑1A, launched on SpaceX’s Transporter‑18 mission, made India the fourth country to possess which capability?
national_questions.qh: स्पेसएक्स के ट्रांसपोर्टर‑18 मिशन पर लॉन्च किए गए MOI‑1A ने भारत को कौन सी क्षमता वाला चौथा देश बना दिया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because MOI‑1A is India’s first orbital‑computing satellite, making India the fourth nation with orbital computing capability after the USA, EU and China.
• Option A is Incorrect; reusable launch vehicle technology is not the specific capability highlighted.
• Option B is Incorrect; quantum communication is not mentioned in the launch.
• Option D is Incorrect; deep‑space navigation was not part of MOI‑1A’s mission.

national_questions.qe: At what speed did the Vande Bharat Express cross both the Chenab Bridge and the Anji Bridge on the Katra‑Banihal section?
national_questions.qh: कत्रा‑बनिहाल सेक्शन पर चेनाब और अंजी दोनों पुलों को पार करते समय वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस की गति कितनी थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because trial runs recorded the Vande Bharat Express travelling at 100 km/h over both bridges.
• Option A is Incorrect; 80 km/h was the earlier permissible speed on the section.
• Option B is Incorrect; 90 km/h was never authorized for this stretch.
• Option D is Incorrect; 120 km/h exceeds the design speed limit of the bridges.

national_questions.qe: Which archer won India’s first women’s individual recurve gold at the 2026 Asian Games?
national_questions.qh: 2026 एशियन गेम्स में भारत की पहली महिला व्यक्तिगत रीकॉव स्वर्ण पदक किस तीरंदाज़ ने जीता?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because 17‑year‑old Kumkum Mohod clinched the gold in the women’s individual recurve event.
• Option A is Incorrect; Deepika Kumari has not won this particular medal.
• Option B is Incorrect; Atanu Das competes in the men’s category.
• Option C is Incorrect; Ankita Bhakat did not secure the gold in 2026.

national_questions.qe: Which oil terminal became India’s first plastic‑free terminal in 2026?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में भारत का पहला प्लास्टिक‑फ्री तेल टर्मिनल कौन सा बना?
oe: Jawahar Dweep (Butcher Island) Marine Oil Terminal
oh: जवाहर द्वीप (बचर द्वीप) समुद्री तेल टर्मिनल
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Jawahar Dweep Marine Oil Terminal off Mumbai was declared plastic‑free, eliminating single‑use plastics.
• Option A is Incorrect; Kandla has not announced a plastic‑free status.
• Option C is Incorrect; Paradip’s terminal still uses conventional plastic packaging.
• Option D is Incorrect; Nhava Sheva has not implemented a complete plastic‑free policy for its oil terminal.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry is the PM-SETU scheme being implemented?
national_questions.qh: PM‑SETU योजना किस मंत्रालय के तहत लागू की जा रही है?
oe: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because PM‑SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) is a flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, with a total outlay of Rs 60,000 crore and the identification of 850 ITIs in hub‑spoke clusters.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Education is not the nodal agency for this skill‑oriented scheme.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Labour and Employment does not administer PM‑SETU.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Finance only provides budgetary approval, not scheme implementation.

national_questions.qe: According to the Finance Minister at the 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave, India's general‑government debt is projected to be what percent of GDP in 2031?
national_questions.qh: 5वें काउटिल्य आर्थिक सम्मेलन में वित्त मंत्री के अनुसार, 2031 में भारत का सामान्य‑सरकारी ऋण जीडीपी के कितने प्रतिशत होगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Finance Minister cited IMF projections that general‑government debt will fall from 83.4% of GDP in 2026 to 77.7% in 2031.
• Option A is Incorrect; 80.5% is not the figure mentioned.
• Option C is Incorrect; 83.4% refers to the 2026 projection, not 2031.
• Option D is Incorrect; 85.0% is higher than the projected decline.

national_questions.qe: Which bridge, India's first cable‑stayed railway bridge, was crossed by Vande Bharat Express at 100 km/h?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला केबल‑स्टेड रेलवे पुल, जिसे वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस ने 100 किमी/घंटा की गति से पार किया, कौन‑सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Anji Bridge on the Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link is India's first cable‑stayed railway bridge, and Vande Bharat Express trains successfully crossed it at a permissible speed of 100 km/h.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Chenab Bridge is a suspension arch bridge, not a cable‑stayed structure.
• Option B is Incorrect; Bogibeel Bridge is a road‑rail bridge over the Brahmaputra, not a cable‑stayed railway bridge.
• Option D is Incorrect; Pamban Bridge is a sea‑link railway bridge, not cable‑stayed.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian waterway was revived as an international cargo route linking Dibrugarh in Assam to Pangaon Port in Bangladesh?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय जलमार्ग असम के दिब्रुगढ़ को बांग्लादेश के पंगाओन पोर्ट से जोड़ते हुए अंतरराष्ट्रीय माल मार्ग के रूप में पुनर्जीवित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the cargo vessel used the Brahmaputra (National Waterway‑2) to sail from Dibrugarh to Pangaon.
• Option B is Incorrect; National Waterway‑1 runs along the Ganga, not the Brahmaputra.
• Option C is Incorrect; National Waterway‑3 lies on the west‑coast of India.
• Option D is Incorrect; National Waterway‑4 is on the east‑coast, unrelated to the Assam‑Bangladesh route.

national_questions.qe: What is the length of India's first free‑space quantum key distribution (QKD) link established between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar?
national_questions.qh: बीआईएसएजी‑एन और आईआईटी गांधीनगर के बीच स्थापित भारत का पहला फ्री‑स्पेस क्वांटम की वितरण (QKD) लिंक कितनी लंबाई का है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the link spans 5.56 km as reported.
• Option A is Incorrect; 3.2 km is shorter than the actual length.
• Option B is Incorrect; 4.5 km does not match the stated distance.
• Option D is Incorrect; 7.0 km exceeds the reported length.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state is hosting the country's first AI Data Centre Park with a planned 100‑MW AI‑ready campus?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य 100 मेगावॉट AI‑रेडी कैंपस के साथ देश का पहला AI डेटा सेंटर पार्क स्थापित कर रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the AI Data Centre Park is being set up in Chhattisgarh with a 100‑MW campus.
• Option A is Incorrect; Karnataka has no mention of this specific AI park.
• Option B is Incorrect; Maharashtra is not the announced location.
• Option C is Incorrect; Gujarat is not cited for this project.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry is the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana‑Gramin (PMAY‑G) scheme administered, under which Andhra Pradesh is piloting 3D‑printed rural houses?
national_questions.qh: अंडर किस मंत्रालय के तहत प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना‑ग्रामीण (PMAY‑G) कार्यान्वित है, जिसके अंतर्गत आंध्र प्रदेश 3डी‑प्रिंटेड ग्रामीण घरों का पायलट चला रहा है?
oe: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because PMAY‑G is a flagship rural housing scheme administered by the Ministry of Rural Development.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs handles the urban component (PMAY‑U).
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy deals with renewable energy projects, not housing.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce is unrelated to housing schemes.

national_questions.qe: Which state’s port authority installed India’s first offshore wind turbine at V. O. Chidambaranar Port?
national_questions.qh: कौन से राज्य के पोर्ट अथॉरिटी ने वी. ओ. चिदंबरनर पोर्ट में भारत का पहला ऑफ़शोर विंड टरबाइन स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because V. O. Chidambaranar Port is located in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, and the Tamil Nadu government’s port authority installed the turbine.
• Option A is Incorrect because Kerala does not host this port.
• Option C is Incorrect because Maharashtra’s ports are on the western coast, not Thoothukudi.
• Option D is Incorrect because Gujarat’s offshore wind projects are elsewhere.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for the construction of India’s first underwater road‑cum‑rail tunnel in Assam?
national_questions.qh: असम में भारत के पहले अंडरवॉटर रोड‑क्यूम‑रेल टनल के निर्माण के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय मुख्य एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the tunnel is a road‑rail project and the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways is the nodal agency for such infrastructure.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Railways ministry handles rail‑only projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Shipping ministry deals with maritime transport, not land tunnels.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Home Affairs ministry is unrelated to civil infrastructure.

national_questions.qe: Which two institutions were linked in India’s first free‑space quantum key distribution (QKD) demonstration?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले फ्री‑स्पेस क्वांटम की‑डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन (QKD) प्रदर्शन में किन दो संस्थानों को जोड़ा गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the 5.56 km free‑space QKD link was demonstrated between the BISAG‑N testbed and IIT Gandhinagar.
• Option A is Incorrect; ISRO and DRDO collaborate on space and defence, not this QKD trial.
• Option B is Incorrect; those institutes were not part of the demonstration.
• Option C is Incorrect; NIT Trichy and BARC were not involved.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry will the Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA) be established?
national_questions.qh: इंटीग्रेटेड ट्रांसपोर्ट एंड लॉजिस्टिक्स अथॉरिटी (ITLA) किस मंत्रालय के तहत स्थापित होगी?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
oh: राज्य सड़क परिवहन एवं राजमार्ग मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Cabinet decision placed ITLA under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry to coordinate multi‑modal logistics.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways handles roads only.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Ministry of Railways focuses solely on rail transport.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Ministry of Finance does not oversee operational logistics authorities.

national_questions.qe: As of the latest report, how many cumulative teleconsultations have been recorded on the eSanjeevani platform?
national_questions.qh: नवीनतम रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, ई‑संजीवनी प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर कुल कितनी टेली‑कंसल्टेशन हुई हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the platform crossed the 50 crore (500 million) teleconsultation milestone.
• Option A is Incorrect; the figure is far lower than the reported milestone.
• Option B is Incorrect; 25 crore is half of the actual count.
• Option D is Incorrect; 75 crore exceeds the current cumulative total.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian vaccine manufacturer developed Cervavac, the country's first indigenous HPV vaccine?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी एचपीवी वैक्सीन, सर्वावैक, किस भारतीय वैक्सीन निर्माता ने विकसित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Cervavac was developed by the Serum Institute of India in collaboration with DBT‑BIRAC and other partners.
• Option A is Incorrect; Bharat Biotech is known for other vaccines but not Cervavac.
• Option B is Incorrect; Panacea Biotec did not develop this HPV vaccine.
• Option C is Incorrect; Biological E. Limited is not associated with Cervavac.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India’s first indigenous fleet support ship built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited?
national_questions.qh: हिंदुस्तान शिपयार्ड लिमिटेड द्वारा निर्मित भारत का पहला स्वदेशी फ्लीट सपोर्ट शिप किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the ship launched on 23 May 2026 is officially named FSS‑1 ‘Surya’, the first indigenous fleet support ship for the Indian Navy.
• Option A is Incorrect because INS Shakti is a replenishment tanker commissioned earlier, not the first indigenous FSS.
• Option C is Incorrect because INS Jyoti is a different auxiliary vessel.
• Option D is Incorrect because INS Deepak is a modern fleet tanker, not the first indigenous fleet support ship.

national_questions.qe: What was the distance over which India’s first free‑space quantum key distribution trial was successfully demonstrated?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले फ्री‑स्पेस क्वांटम की‑डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन परीक्षण की सफल दूरी कितनी थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the trial between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar covered a free‑space link of 5.56 km.
• Option A is Incorrect; 2.3 km was not the reported distance.
• Option B is Incorrect; 4.0 km does not match the experimental setup.
• Option D is Incorrect; 10 km exceeds the actual demonstrated range.

national_questions.qe: On which railway section did the Vande Bharat Express achieve a speed of 100 km/h across the Chenab and Anji bridges?
national_questions.qh: वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस ने चेनाब और अंजि पुलों पर १०० किमी/घंटा की गति किस रेलवे सेक्शन में हासिल की?
oe: Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link
oh: उधमपुर‑स्रीनगर‑बरामुड़ा रेल लिंक का कटरा‑बनिहाल सेक्शन
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the speed trial was conducted on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal stretch of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising permissible speed to 100 km/h.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Delhi‑Mumbai corridor was not involved in this test.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Howrah‑Chennai route is unrelated.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Pune‑Mumbai line was not part of the trial.

national_questions.qe: Which joint initiative featuring MY Bharat Volunteers and NCC Cadets was launched to promote youth-led community mobilization for the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan?
national_questions.qh: टीबी मुक्त भारत अभियान के लिए युवा-नेतृत्व वाली सामुदायिक लामबंदी को बढ़ावा देने के लिए माय भारत (MY Bharat) स्वयंसेवकों और एनसीसी कैडेटों को मिलाकर कौन सी संयुक्त पहल शुरू की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams bring together Class-I Officers, MY Bharat Volunteers, and NCC Cadets across 55 districts to accelerate the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
• Option A is Incorrect because AMRIT refers to affordable medicine outlets.
• Option C is Incorrect because SEVA Brigades is not a registered health squad under this ministry framework.
• Option D is Incorrect because SANKALP is associated with skill development initiatives.

national_questions.qe: Under the BHAVYA Rasayan Scheme and Critical Mineral Mission, by which target year does the Government of India aim to transform the Indian chemical sector into a USD 1 trillion industry?
national_questions.qh: भव्य रसायन योजना और क्रिटिकल मिनरल मिशन के तहत, भारत सरकार का लक्ष्य किस लक्षित वर्ष तक भारतीय रसायन क्षेत्र को 1 ट्रिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर का उद्योग बनाना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Government of India announced a target to develop the Indian chemical sector into a USD 1 trillion industry by 2040 during the launch of India Chem.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2030 is too short-term for achieving a $1 trillion sector milestone.
• Option B is Incorrect because 2035 is not the officially set target year for this roadmap.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2047 is the overall target year for 'Viksit Bharat' rather than the chemical sector specific target.

national_questions.qe: Under the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) signed between India and EFTA nations, what amount of investment is targeted to be attracted into India over a 15-year period?
national_questions.qh: भारत और ईएफटीए (EFTA) देशों के बीच हस्ताक्षरित व्यापार और आर्थिक साझेदारी समझौते (TEPA) के तहत 15 वर्षों की अवधि में भारत में कितने निवेश को आकर्षित करने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because TEPA aims to attract USD 100 billion in investment and generate 10 lakh direct jobs in India over a span of 15 years.
• Option A is Incorrect because USD 25 billion is far lower than the bilateral commitment.
• Option B is Incorrect because USD 50 billion represents only half of the agreed investment goal.
• Option C is Incorrect because USD 75 billion does not match the official TEPA commitment figures.

national_questions.qe: Which indigenously designed Indian Navy vessel, the first fleet support ship, was launched by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh at Hindustan Shipyard Limited?

national_questions.qe: The Supreme Court directed the Centre to ensure uninterrupted operation of which urban transport service?
national_questions.qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने केंद्र को किस शहरी परिवहन सेवा के निरंतर संचालन को सुनिश्चित करने का निर्देश दिया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Court specifically ordered that metro services be maintained without disruption.
• Option B is Incorrect as city bus services were not mentioned in the directive.
• Option C is Incorrect because inter‑state rail freight was not part of the order.
• Option D is Incorrect since domestic airline operations were not addressed by the Court.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the recent modernization of Indian lighthouses?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय लाइटहाउस के हालिया आधुनिकीकरण की निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी विशेषता नहीं है?
oe: Installation of Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations
Development of lighthouse sites as tourism destinations
oh: सभी लाइटहाउस सौर ऊर्जा से चलते हैं
ऑटोमैटिक आइडेंटिफिकेशन सिस्टम (AIS) शोर स्टेशन की स्थापना
लाइटहाउस स्थलों को पर्यटन गंतव्य के रूप में विकसित करना
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because none of the lighthouses have been converted to nuclear power; they are solar‑powered.
• Option A is Incorrect because all Indian lighthouses have indeed been made 100 % solar‑powered.
• Option B is Incorrect because 87 AIS shore stations have been installed at lighthouse locations.
• Option D is Incorrect as many lighthouses have been developed with museums, pathways and gardens for tourism.

national_questions.qe: Which state's Visakhapatnam ITI cluster became the first in India to receive PM‑SETU approval?
national_questions.qh: कौन से राज्य का विशाखापत्तनम आईटीआई क्लस्टर भारत में पहला पीएम‑सेटु अनुमोदन प्राप्त करने वाला बना?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Visakhapatnam ITI cluster in Andhra Pradesh was the first ITI cluster in India to receive approval from the PM‑SETU National Steering Committee, with a Rs 200 crore investment to upgrade four government ITIs.
• Option B is Incorrect because Karnataka has not yet reported a PM‑SETU‑approved ITI cluster.
• Option C is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu’s ITI clusters are yet to obtain PM‑SETU clearance.
• Option D is Incorrect because Maharashtra’s ITI initiatives are separate from the PM‑SETU scheme mentioned.

national_questions.qe: According to the IEA Oil Market Report, what is the projected global oil supply (in million barrels per day) for the current year?
national_questions.qh: IEA के तेल बाजार रिपोर्ट के अनुसार इस वर्ष वैश्विक तेल आपूर्ति (मिलियन बैरल प्रति दिन) कितनी अनुमानित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the IEA projects global oil supply to decline to 100.7 million barrels per day this year before rebounding in 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect because 95.3 million bpd is lower than the IEA forecast.
• Option B is Incorrect because 98.5 million bpd does not match the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect because 103.2 million bpd exceeds the IEA projection.

national_questions.qe: What is the new name given to the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) for the period 2026‑27 to 2030‑31 as approved by the Union Cabinet?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय कैबिनेट ने 2026-27 से 2030-31 तक राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम (NSAP) का नया नाम क्या रखा?
oe: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
oh: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Union Cabinet renamed NSAP as Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana for 2026‑27 to 2030‑31.
• Option B is Incorrect; Jan Dhan Yojana is a financial inclusion scheme, not a social assistance programme.
• Option C is Incorrect; MGNREGA is a rural employment guarantee act.
• Option D is Incorrect; Swachh Bharat Mission pertains to sanitation, not social assistance.

national_questions.qe: To what level has India's public debt‑to‑GDP ratio fallen over the past five years, as announced at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum?
national_questions.qh: पिछले पाँच वर्षों में भारत का सार्वजनिक ऋण‑से‑जीडीपी अनुपात किस स्तर तक गिरा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the ratio fell from 61 % to 55 % over the last five years.
• Option A is Incorrect; 61 % was the earlier level before the decline.
• Option C is Incorrect; 45 % is not the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 70 % is higher than the current ratio.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry was represented by Union Minister Bhupender Yadav during the launch of public EV charging stations and air‑quality monitoring stations in New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: न्यू दिल्ली में सार्वजनिक ई‑वी चार्जिंग स्टेशन और वायु‑गुणवत्ता मॉनिटरिंग स्टेशन के उद्घाटन के दौरान केंद्रीय मंत्री भूपेंद्र यादव ने किस मंत्रालय का प्रतिनिधित्व किया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
गृह एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Bhupender Yadav is the Union Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, the nodal ministry for EV‑charging infrastructure and ambient air‑quality monitoring.
• Option B is Incorrect as the Ministry of Power did not lead this Delhi launch.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs was not involved.
• Option D is Incorrect as the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways was not represented.

national_questions.qe: Who supervised the Special Intensive Voter Enrolment Drive conducted in Jammu & Kashmir on October 10‑11, 2024?
national_questions.qh: 10‑11 अक्टूबर 2024 को जम्मू और कश्मीर में आयोजित विशेष तीव्र मतदाता नामांकन अभियान की निगरानी किसने की?
oe: Chief Electoral Officer of Jammu & Kashmir
oh: जम्मू और कश्मीर के मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the drive was supervised by the Chief Electoral Officer of Jammu & Kashmir under the Election Commission’s guidelines.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Election Commission of India set the overall policy but did not directly supervise the field operation.
• Option C is Incorrect as the Ministry of Home Affairs was not the supervising authority.
• Option D is Incorrect because the State Election Commission deals with local body elections, not parliamentary voter enrolment.

national_questions.qe: Which agency installed the 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations at Indian lighthouses?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय लाइटहाउसों में 87 ऑटोमैटिक आइडेंटिफिकेशन सिस्टम (AIS) शोर स्टेशन किस एजेंसी ने स्थापित किए?
oe: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL)
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL) is the nodal agency that installed the AIS shore stations to modernise navigation.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Directorate General of Shipping oversees shipping regulations, not lighthouse AIS installations.
• Option B is Incorrect as the Ministry of Tourism promotes tourism but does not handle navigational equipment.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Indian Coast Guard operates patrols, not lighthouse infrastructure.

national_questions.qe: What is the revised target for creating Lakhpati Didis announced at the National SARAS Mela 2026?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय SARAS मेले 2026 में लखपति दिदियों के लिए निर्धारित नया लक्ष्य क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Union Rural Development Minister announced a new target of 6 crore Lakhpati Didis.
• Option A is Incorrect as the earlier target of 3 crore has already been achieved.
• Option B is Incorrect because 4 crore was never announced.
• Option C is Incorrect because 5 crore is not the stated target.

national_questions.qe: What was the value of India's defence exports in FY 2025‑26 as announced by the Defence Minister?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025‑26 में भारत के रक्षा निर्यात का मूल्य रक्षा मंत्री द्वारा किस राशि के रूप में घोषित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the minister stated that defence exports crossed ₹38,000 crore in FY 2025‑26.
• Option A is Incorrect; ₹3,860 crore is far below the reported figure.
• Option C is Incorrect; ₹380 crore is not the announced amount.
• Option D is Incorrect; ₹38 lakh crore is a mis‑representation of the actual value.

national_questions.qe: What was the total sales value of Khadi and Village Industries products in FY 2025‑26?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025‑26 में खादी एवं ग्राम उद्योग उत्पादों की कुल बिक्री मूल्य क्या था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because KVIC reported sales of ₹1.87 lakh crore in FY 2025‑26.
• Option A is Incorrect; ₹1.5 lakh crore understates the actual sales.
• Option B is Incorrect; ₹1.6 lakh crore is not the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; ₹2.0 lakh crore exceeds the stated amount.

national_questions.qe: Which airport in India has inaugurated the country's first terminal equipped with geothermal heating?
national_questions.qh: कौन से हवाई अड्डे ने भारत का पहला जियोथर्मल हीटिंग वाला टर्मिनल inaugurated किया है?
oe: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai
oh: कुशोक बकुला रिम्पोचे हवाई अड्डा, लेह
इंदिरा गांधी अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, दिल्ली
छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, मुंबई
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport terminal in Leh was inaugurated as India’s first airport terminal with geothermal heating, enhancing energy efficiency in a high‑altitude region.
• Option B is Incorrect; Delhi’s IGI Airport does not have a geothermal‑heated terminal.
• Option C is Incorrect; Mumbai’s airport uses conventional HVAC systems.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bengaluru’s airport also lacks geothermal heating.

national_questions.qe: Which two projects were inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Ladakh under the Rs 3,350 crore development plan?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने लद्दाख में 3,350 करोड़ रुपये के विकास योजना के तहत कौन से दो प्रोजेक्ट्स का उद्घाटन किया?
oe: A new highway and a solar farm
Geothermal‑heated airport terminal at Leh and the Petroglyph Conservation Park
An international university and a space research centre
A hydroelectric dam and a wildlife sanctuary
oh: एक नई हाईवे और एक सोलर फार्म
लेह में जियोथर्मल‑हीटेड हवाई अड्डा टर्मिनल और पेट्रोग्लिफ़ संरक्षण पार्क
एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय विश्वविद्यालय और एक अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान केंद्र
एक जलविद्युत बाँध और एक वन्यजीव अभयारण्य
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because PM Modi inaugurated the geothermal‑heated terminal at Leh Airport and the dedicated Petroglyph Conservation Park, both part of the ₹3,350 crore Ladakh development package.
• Option A is Incorrect; the mentioned highway and solar farm were not part of the announced Rs 3,350 crore projects.
• Option C is Incorrect; no university or space centre was launched under this scheme.
• Option D is Incorrect; neither a dam nor a sanctuary was inaugurated in this context.

national_questions.qe: As of 2026, how many kilometres of viaduct have been completed for the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad high‑speed rail corridor?
national_questions.qh: 2026 तक मुंबई‑अहमदाबाद हाई‑स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के लिए कितने किलोमीटर वायडक्ट पूरा हो चुका है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because official updates state that 371 km of viaduct have been completed for the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad bullet‑train project.
• Option A is Incorrect; 200 km is far below the reported progress.
• Option B is Incorrect; 250 km does not match the official figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 508 km represents the total corridor length, not the completed viaduct portion.

national_questions.qe: Which agency has become India's first test agency to provide integrated vehicle cybersecurity testing, verification, validation, R&D and homologation under one roof?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी एजेंसी भारत की पहली परीक्षण एजेंसी बन गई है जो एक ही छत के तहत एकीकृत वाहन साइबर सुरक्षा परीक्षण, सत्यापन, मान्यकरण, अनुसंधान एवं विकास और होमोलोगेशन प्रदान करती है?
oe: National Automotive Testing and R&D Infrastructure (NATRiP)
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
oh: नेशनल ऑटोमोटिव टेस्टिंग एंड आरएंडडी इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर (NATRiP)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ARAI was announced as India's first test agency offering integrated vehicle cybersecurity services, covering AIS‑189, AIS‑190 compliance, VAPT, TARA, HSM, SSM and CVE tracking.
• Option B is Incorrect because NATRiP is a testing infrastructure network but has not been designated as the first integrated vehicle cybersecurity service provider.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry formulates policy but does not directly conduct integrated testing.
• Option D is Incorrect because SIAM is an industry body, not a testing agency.

national_questions.qe: In which Indian city will IBM install the country's first quantum computer, scheduled to become operational in early 2027?
national_questions.qh: किस भारतीय शहर में IBM देश का पहला क्वांटम कंप्यूटर स्थापित करेगा, जो 2027 की शुरुआत में संचालन में आएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because IBM announced the installation of India's first quantum computer at the Andhra Pradesh Quantum Valley tech park in Amaravati, expected to be operational in early 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect as Bengaluru hosts several tech initiatives but not this specific quantum computer project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Hyderabad is not the designated location for this IBM quantum installation.
• Option D is Incorrect as Mumbai has no announced plan for the first national quantum computer deployment.

national_questions.qe: In which city has the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies (IICT) set up its campus to build industry-ready talent for the AVGC sector?
national_questions.qh: AVGC (एनिमेशन, विजुअल इफेक्ट्स, गेमिंग और कॉमिक्स) क्षेत्र में प्रतिभा विकसित करने के लिए 'भारतीय रचनात्मक प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान' (IICT) ने किस शहर में अपना परिसर स्थापित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting operationalized the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies (IICT) at a temporary campus in Mumbai to foster AVGC, XR, and gaming talent.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru is recognized for its technology software hubs, not IICT.
• Option B is Incorrect because Hyderabad hosts major animation studios but IICT was established in Mumbai.
• Option D is Incorrect because New Delhi serves as administrative headquarters for MIB.

national_questions.qe: India expressed strong solidarity and condemned recent attacks targeting civil infrastructure and energy installations in which West Asian nation?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने हाल ही में किस पश्चिम एशियाई देश के नागरिक बुनियादी ढांचे और ऊर्जा प्रतिष्ठानों को निशाना बनाकर किए गए हमलों की कड़ी निंदा करते हुए उसके प्रति अपनी एकजुटता व्यक्त की?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India officially condemned attacks on civil infrastructure including Aramco facilities in Saudi Arabia, reaffirming commitment to Saudi sovereignty.
• Option A is Incorrect because the specific diplomatic statement and condemnation were issued regarding infrastructure attacks in Saudi Arabia.
• Option B is Incorrect because Qatar was not the target of the recent civil infrastructure attacks mentioned by MEA.
• Option C is Incorrect because Iran was not the target country in this official Ministry of External Affairs solidarity statement.

national_questions.qe: The Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM), which monitors agricultural residue burning and air pollution, was established under which statutory enactment?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग (CAQM), जो कृषि अवशेष जलाने और वायु प्रदूषण की निगरानी करता है, किस वैधानिक अधिनियम के तहत स्थापित किया गया था?
oe: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021
oh: राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग अधिनियम, 2021
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) was established under a dedicated parliamentary legislation, the CAQM Act, 2021, to coordinate air quality improvement measures and stubble burning controls.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Air Act of 1981 provided for Central and State Pollution Control Boards, not CAQM.
• Option B is Incorrect because while earlier temporary bodies like EPCA were set up under EPA 1986, CAQM operates under its distinct 2021 statute.
• Option D is Incorrect because the NGT Act, 2010 relates to judicial adjudication of environmental disputes.

national_questions.qe: Which primary payload aboard India's Aditya-L1 solar mission is specifically designed to continuously observe the solar corona and Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs)?
national_questions.qh: भारत के आदित्य-L1 सौर मिशन पर कौन सा प्राथमिक पेलोड विशेष रूप से सौर कोरोना और कोरोनल मास इजेक्शन (CMEs) का निरंतर अवलोकन करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
oe: High Energy L1 Orbiting X-ray Spectrometer (HEL1OS)
oh: हाई एनर्जी L1 ऑर्बिटिंग एक्स-रे स्पेक्ट्रोमीटर (HEL1OS)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) is the primary payload developed by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA) to image the solar corona and study coronal mass ejections.
• Option A is Incorrect because PAPA measures solar wind composition and energetic ions.
• Option C is Incorrect because SoLEXS measures low-energy X-ray flux from the Sun.
• Option D is Incorrect because HEL1OS studies high-energy solar X-ray flares.

national_questions.qe: Which vessel holds the distinction of being the first major warship constructed by a private shipyard to be commissioned into the Indian Navy?
national_questions.qh: निजी शिपयार्ड द्वारा निर्मित किस जहाज को भारतीय नौसेना में शामिल होने वाले पहले प्रमुख युद्धपोत होने का गौरव प्राप्त है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because INS Samarthak is the first major warship built by a private sector shipyard (L&T Kattupalli in Tamil Nadu) and commissioned into the Indian Navy with over 75% indigenous content.
• Option B is Incorrect because INS Ikshak is a Survey Vessel (Large) constructed by public sector shipyard GRSE.
• Option C is Incorrect because INS Nirdeshak is also a public-sector survey vessel.
• Option D is Incorrect because INS Surat is a Visakhapatnam-class stealth guided missile destroyer built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL).

national_questions.qe: Which instrument aboard Aditya‑L1 is specifically designed to observe the solar corona?
national_questions.qh: अडित्य‑L1 में कौन सा उपकरण विशेष रूप से सौर कोरोना का अवलोकन करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) on Aditya‑L1 is dedicated to imaging the solar corona and studying coronal mass ejections and solar flares.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Solar X‑ray Monitor observes X‑ray flux, not the corona directly.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope studies the chromosphere and transition region, not the corona.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Magnetometer measures magnetic fields, not coronal structures.

national_questions.qe: In which year did ISRO successfully launch its first indigenous satellite launch vehicle, SLV‑3?
national_questions.qh: आईएसआरओ ने अपना पहला स्वदेशी सैटेलाइट लॉन्च वाहन, SLV‑3, सफलतापूर्वक कब लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because SLV‑3 lifted off on 20 July 1980, placing the Rohini satellite into orbit and marking India’s first indigenous launch capability.
• Option A is Incorrect; 1975 predates the development of SLV‑3.
• Option B is Incorrect; the vehicle was still under testing in 1978.
• Option D is Incorrect; by 1982 ISRO had already moved on to the PSLV program.

national_questions.qe: According to the Department of Space, to what estimated value is India's space economy projected to grow over the next 7 to 8 years from its present valuation of around $9 billion?
national_questions.qh: अंतरिक्ष विभाग के अनुसार, भारत की वर्तमान लगभग $9 बिलियन की अंतरिक्ष अर्थव्यवस्था के अगले 7 से 8 वर्षों में बढ़कर कितने डॉलर तक पहुँचने का अनुमान है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Union Minister of State for Space Dr. Jitendra Singh stated that India's space economy, currently valued at around $9 billion, is projected to expand to $40–45 billion over the next 7 to 8 years due to structural reforms, IN-SPACe, and private sector integration.
• Option A is Incorrect: $20–25 billion is an understated figure below the official projection target.
• Option C is Incorrect: $60–65 billion exceeds the government's medium-term targeted range.
• Option D is Incorrect: $80–90 billion is significantly higher than the present official forecast.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry recently made Aadhaar authentication or proof of possession mandatory for availing scholarship benefits under the PM CARES for Children Scheme?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय ने 'पीएम केयर्स फॉर चिल्ड्रेन योजना' के तहत छात्रवृत्ति का लाभ उठाने के लिए आधार सत्यापन या आधार रखने के प्रमाण को अनिवार्य किया है?
oe: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment issued a notification making Aadhaar authentication mandatory for students to receive scholarship benefits under the PM CARES for Children Scheme.
• Option A is Incorrect: The Ministry of Education oversees general national education policies but did not issue this specific requirement.
• Option B is Incorrect: Although PM CARES for Children was instituted for child welfare, this scholarship authentication rule was formally notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
• Option D is Incorrect: The Ministry of Home Affairs is responsible for internal security, not welfare scholarship implementations.

national_questions.qe: Where was India’s first indigenously constructed Multi-Purpose Vessel (MPV), 'INS Samarthak', officially commissioned into the Indian Navy?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय नौसेना के पहले स्वदेशी निर्मित बहुउद्देश्यीय पोत (MPV) 'आईएनएस समर्थक' (INS Samarthak) को किस नौसेना बेस पर कमीशन किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because INS Samarthak, India's first Multi-Purpose Vessel (MPV) built by a private shipyard with 75% indigenous content, was commissioned at the Karwar Naval Base in Karnataka.
• Option B is Incorrect because Visakhapatnam is the HQ of the Eastern Naval Command, not the commissioning site for INS Samarthak.
• Option C is Incorrect because Kochi serves as the Southern Naval Command headquarters.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mumbai is the Western Naval Command HQ, but the vessel was commissioned at Karwar.

national_questions.qe: At which ISRO center were the critical Crew Module-Service Module (CM-SM) separation tests for the Gaganyaan human spaceflight mission successfully conducted?
national_questions.qh: भारत के गगनयान मानव अंतरिक्ष उड़ान मिशन के लिए महत्वपूर्ण क्रू मॉड्यूल-सर्विस मॉड्यूल (CM-SM) पृथक्करण परीक्षण इसरो के किस केंद्र में सफलतापूर्वक संपन्न हुआ?
oe: U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru
oh: यू आर राव उपग्रह केंद्र (URSC), बेंगलुरु
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) in Thiruvananthapuram successfully conducted the Crew Module-Service Module (CM-SM) separation tests, validating the pyrotechnic separation mechanisms for Gaganyaan.
• Option A is Incorrect because SDSC Sriharikota is the primary spaceport launch facility, not where this separation test took place.
• Option B is Incorrect because SAC Ahmedabad develops payloads and sensors.
• Option D is Incorrect because URSC Bengaluru focuses on satellite design and integration.

national_questions.qe: Which airport in India features the country's first passenger terminal powered by a geothermal-heating system?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला भू-तापीय हीटिंग (Geothermal-heating) प्रणाली से संचालित पैसेंजर टर्मिनल किस हवाई अड्डे पर स्थापित किया गया है?
oe: Veer Savarkar International Airport, Port Blair
oh: वीर सावरकर अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, पोर्ट ब्लेयर
कुशोक बकुला रिम्पोचे हवाई अड्डा, लेह
श्रीनगर अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, जम्मू और कश्मीर
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport in Leh, Ladakh, features India's first geothermal-heating powered passenger terminal built at a cost of ₹640 crore.
• Option A is Incorrect because Port Blair airport is located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and does not utilize geothermal heating.
• Option C is Incorrect because Pakyong Airport is a greenfield airport in Sikkim.
• Option D is Incorrect because Srinagar International Airport is located in Jammu & Kashmir and does not host this geothermal terminal.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian multi‑wavelength space observatory, launched on 28 September 2015, continues to operate beyond its planned five‑year mission life?
national_questions.qh: 28 सितंबर 2015 को लॉन्च किया गया और नियोजित पाँच‑साल के मिशन जीवन से अधिक कार्यरत रहने वाला भारतीय बहु‑तरंगदैर्घ्य अंतरिक्ष अवलोकन यंत्र कौन‑सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because AstroSat is India’s first dedicated multi‑wavelength space observatory launched on 28 Sep 2015 and has been operating beyond its 5‑year design life.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chandrayaan‑2 is a lunar mission, not a multi‑wavelength observatory.
• Option C is Incorrect because GSAT‑30 is a communication satellite.
• Option D is Incorrect because RISAT‑2 is a radar imaging satellite.

national_questions.qe: The Crew Module–Service Module (CM‑SM) separation tests being conducted in 2026 are part of which Indian human spaceflight mission?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में किए जा रहे क्रू मॉड्यूल‑सर्विस मॉड्यूल (CM‑SM) पृथक्करण परीक्षण किस भारतीय मानव अंतरिक्ष मिशन का हिस्सा हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the CM‑SM separation tests are a critical milestone for India’s first crewed mission, Gaganyaan, scheduled for launch by end‑2026.
• Option A is Incorrect; Vikram is the name of the lander for Chandrayaan‑2, not a crewed mission.
• Option C is Incorrect; Shukrayaan is a planned Venus mission.
• Option D is Incorrect; Aditya‑L1 is a solar‑observing satellite.

national_questions.qe: Mormugao Port Authority obtained a 20‑year authorization for a captive non‑public network (CNPN) under which legislation?
national_questions.qh: मोरमुगा पोर्ट अथॉरिटी ने 20‑वर्षीय कैप्टिव नॉन‑पब्लिक नेटवर्क (CNPN) के लिए किस अधिनियम के तहत अनुमति प्राप्त की?
oe: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997
oh: टेलीकॉम रेगुलेटरी अथॉरिटी ऑफ इंडिया अधिनियम, 1997
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Department of Telecommunications granted the CNPN authorization to Mormugao Port under the Telecommunications Act 2023.
• Option A is Incorrect; the TRAI Act deals with regulatory functions, not CNPN authorizations.
• Option B is Incorrect; the IT Act pertains to cyber‑law, not telecom network licensing.
• Option D is Incorrect; the policy provides a framework but does not itself confer legal authorization.

national_questions.qe: What is the projected value of India's space economy by the end of the decade as highlighted by Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh?
national_questions.qh: जूनियर मंत्री डॉ. जितेंद्र सिंह ने भारत की अंतरिक्ष अर्थव्यवस्था के अनुमानित मूल्य को दशक के अंत तक कितने अरब डॉलर बताया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the minister said the space sector is moving towards a $40–45 billion economy.
• Option A is Incorrect because the projected figure is higher than $20‑25 billion.
• Option B is Incorrect as the estimate exceeds $30‑35 billion.
• Option D is Incorrect because the projection does not reach $50‑55 billion.
• Category: Science, Technology, Defense & Space
• Exam Tag: SSC CGL

national_questions.qe: According to the Election Commission's directive, what is the qualifying date for the Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls in the 17 states and UTs?
national_questions.qh: इलेक्शन कमीशन के निर्देश के अनुसार, 17 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में विशेष सारांश संशोधन के लिए पात्रता तिथि क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the EC specified January 1 as the cut‑off date for eligibility.
• Option B is Incorrect; April 1 is an allowed date for advance applications, not the qualifying date.
• Option C is Incorrect; July 1 is another advance‑application date, not the cut‑off.
• Option D is Incorrect; October 1 is also an advance‑application date, not the qualifying date.
• Category: National Polity, Judiciary & Governance
• Exam Tag: SSC CGL

national_questions.qe: How did External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar describe India's position in the emerging international order at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum?
national_questions.qh: ब्लूमबर्ग न्यू इकोनॉमी फोरम में विदेश मंत्री एस. जैशंकर ने उभरते अंतर्राष्ट्रीय क्रम में भारत की स्थिति को कैसे वर्णित किया?
oe: As a power in the middle
oh: एक मध्य शक्ति के रूप में
मध्य में शक्ति के रूप में
एक वैश्विक महाशक्ति के रूप में
एक क्षेत्रीय गठबंधन नेता के रूप में
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Jaishankar said India is a “power in the middle” rather than a middle power.
• Option A is Incorrect; he explicitly rejected the term “middle power.”
• Option C is Incorrect; no claim of being a global superpower was made.
• Option D is Incorrect; the statement did not refer to regional bloc leadership.
• Category: International Relations, Summits & Global Organizations
• Exam Tag: SSC CGL

national_questions.qe: Which ministry launched India's first immunocontraception‑based leopard sterilisation programme in Maharashtra?
national_questions.qh: कौन से मंत्रालय ने महाराष्ट्र में भारत का पहला इम्यूनोकॉन्ट्रासेप्शन‑आधारित तेंदुआ नसबंदी कार्यक्रम शुरू किया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the programme was launched by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) through the Junnar forest division, Pune district.
• Option B is Incorrect as the agriculture ministry is not involved in wildlife population control.
• Option C is Incorrect because health ministry deals with human health, not wildlife management.
• Option D is Incorrect; the home ministry handles internal security, not wildlife conservation.

national_questions.qe: Which organization is partnering with Aaka Space for India's first underwater human spaceflight analog mission in Gujarat?
national_questions.qh: गुजरात में भारत के पहले अंडरवॉटर मानव अंतरिक्ष मिशन के लिए आका स्पेस के साथ साझेदारी करने वाला संगठन कौन है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the mission is being conducted in partnership with the Indian Navy, which provides the underwater facility and logistical support.
• Option A is Incorrect; ISRO is a partner in the broader training ecosystem but not the primary partner for the underwater analog.
• Option C is Incorrect as DRDO is not involved in this civilian space‑training initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Earth Sciences does not partake in astronaut training missions.

national_questions.qe: India's first geothermal‑heating passenger terminal is being built at which airport?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला भू‑तापीय हीटिंग वाला यात्रियों का टर्मिनल किस हवाई अड्डे पर बनाया जा रहा है?
oh: छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the geothermal‑heating passenger terminal is under construction at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport in Leh, Ladakh.
• Option A is Incorrect; Delhi's airport does not have a geothermal heating terminal.
• Option B is Incorrect; Mumbai's airport is not the project site.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bengaluru's airport is unrelated to this Ladakh initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which hospital performed India's first paediatric kidney transplant through donor‑paired exchange?
national_questions.qh: कौन से अस्पताल ने भारत में डोनर‑पेयर्ड एक्सचेंज के माध्यम से पहला बाल किडनी ट्रांसप्लांट किया?
oe: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi
oh: ऑल इंडिया इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ मेडिकल साइंसेज़, दिल्ली
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Aster CMI Hospital, Bengaluru, performed the first paediatric kidney transplant in India using a donor‑paired exchange.
• Option A is Incorrect; AIIMS Delhi has performed kidney transplants but not the first paediatric donor‑paired exchange.
• Option B is Incorrect; Apollo Chennai has not reported this specific milestone.
• Option C is Incorrect; Fortis Mumbai is not the centre of this pioneering procedure.

national_questions.qe: In which Union Territory of India has the first petroglyph conservation park been established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला पेट्रोग्लिफ संरक्षण पार्क किस केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first petroglyph conservation park was launched in Ladakh as part of the ₹3,350 crore development projects announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
• Option A is Incorrect because Jammu & Kashmir does not host this park.
• Option C is Incorrect because Himachal Pradesh is unrelated to the project.
• Option D is Incorrect because Uttarakhand is not the location of the park.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Minister inaugurated India's first site museum at the Adichanallur archaeological site in Tamil Nadu?
national_questions.qh: अडिचनल्लूर पुरातात्विक स्थल पर भारत का पहला साइट संग्रहालय किस केंद्रीय मंत्री ने उद्घाटन किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman inaugurated the museum on 6 August 2023.
• Option B is Incorrect because Amit Shah did not preside over this event.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajnath Singh was not involved.
• Option D is Incorrect because Smriti Irani was not the inaugurating minister.

bihar_questions.qe: How many people were reported as affected by floods in Bihar during September 2026?
bihar_questions.qh: सितंबर 2026 में बिहार में बाढ़ से प्रभावित लोगों की संख्या कितनी थी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar Disaster Management Department data for September 2026 records 50.49 lakh people affected.
• Option B is Incorrect because 48 lakh refers to the 2025 figure.
• Option C is Incorrect because 52.46 lakh pertains to 2024.
• Option D is Incorrect as it is not mentioned in any official report.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the repo rate currently maintained by the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee as mentioned in the recent policy review?
bihar_questions.qh: आरबीआई की मौद्रिक नीति समिति द्वारा हालिया समीक्षा में उल्लेखित मौजूदा रेपो दर क्या है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the article states that the repo rate stands at 5.25 percent.
• Option A is Incorrect because 4.75 percent is not the rate mentioned.
• Option C is Incorrect because 6.00 percent exceeds the cited figure.
• Option D is Incorrect because 6.50 percent is also higher than the stated rate.

bihar_questions.qe: Which organization was the nodal agency for construction of the new double‑line rail bridge over the Ganges at Mokama?
bihar_questions.qh: मोकामा में गंगा पर नए दो‑पटरियों वाले रेल पुल के निर्माण के लिए कौन‑सी संस्था मुख्य एजेंसी थी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the bridge was built by Afcons Infrastructure under the execution agency IRCON, which acted as the nodal body for the project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Indian Railways is the owner/operator, not the construction nodal agency.
• Option C is Incorrect as NHAI deals with highways, not railway bridges.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Shipping has no role in railway bridge construction.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the National Education Policy (NEP), the Bihar Education Department plans to introduce additional regional languages for students of which class group in government schools?
bihar_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) के तहत, बिहार शिक्षा विभाग सरकारी स्कूलों में किस कक्षा वर्ग के छात्रों के लिए अतिरिक्त क्षेत्रीय भाषाएँ शुरू करने की योजना बना रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar Education Department plans to introduce regional languages like Maithili, Bhojpuri, Bajjika, Magahi, or Angika specifically for Classes 1 to 5 in government schools under NEP.
• Option B is Incorrect because the policy initiative targets primary education (Classes 1 to 5) rather than middle school.
• Option C is Incorrect because secondary classes (9-10) are governed by a different curriculum framework.
• Option D is Incorrect because senior secondary classes (11-12) do not fall under this primary language immersion project.

bihar_questions.qe: Which policy launched by the Bihar Government in 2026 mandates procurement preference for goods where at least 25% of manufacturing occurs within the state?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार द्वारा 2026 में लॉन्च की गई कौन सी नीति उन वस्तुओं की खरीद को प्राथमिकता देती है जिनका कम से कम 25% निर्माण राज्य के भीतर होता है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Bihar Purchase Preference Policy, launched in 2026, requires that raw materials and finished goods procured by the state have 25‑40% of their manufacturing within Bihar and is implemented through the GeM portal.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Bihar MSME Policy‑2026 is a broader framework for micro, small and medium enterprises and does not prescribe procurement preference.
• Option B is Incorrect as Make in India is a national programme, not a Bihar‑specific procurement rule.
• Option C is Incorrect; the National Manufacturing Policy is a central policy and does not apply specifically to Bihar’s purchase preferences.

bihar_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for the Varanasi–Kolkata Greenfield Expressway under the Bharatmala Pariyojana?
bihar_questions.qh: वैराणसी‑कोलकाता ग्रीनफ़ील्ड एक्सप्रेसवे के तहत राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग परियोजना के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय नोडल एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
oh: आवास एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Varanasi–Kolkata Greenfield Expressway is being executed under the Bharatmala Pariyojana, which is administered by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Railways handles railway projects, not road expressways.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Shipping deals with maritime infrastructure.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs focuses on urban development, not inter‑state highways.

bihar_questions.qe: Which Union ministry was recommended by the Bihar District Court to overhaul the training curriculum of IAS and IPS officers?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार जिला न्यायालय द्वारा आईएएस और आईपीएस अधिकारियों के प्रशिक्षण पाठ्यक्रम को सुधारने के लिए किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय को अनुशंसा की गई थी?
oe: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
oh: कर्मचारी, सार्वजनिक शिकायत और पेंशन मंत्रालय
bihar_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because the court specifically recommended that the Union Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions overhaul civil‑servant training. • Option A is Incorrect because the Home Ministry was not mentioned. • Option C is Incorrect because the Law Ministry was not involved. • Option D is Incorrect because the Finance Ministry was not referenced.

bihar_questions.qe: Which state notified the Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026, to replace permission-based industrial clearances with self-certification and time-bound approvals?
bihar_questions.qh: अनुमति-आधारित औद्योगिक स्वीकृतियों के स्थान पर स्व-प्रमाणन और समयबद्ध मंजूरी की व्यवस्था लागू करने के लिए किस राज्य ने ईज़ ऑफ डूइंग बिजनेस अधिनियम, 2026 अधिसूचित किया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar government notified the Bihar Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026, to overhaul industrial governance by replacing permission-based clearances with self-certification.
• Option B is Incorrect because Uttar Pradesh did not notify this specific 2026 Act.
• Option C is Incorrect because Jharkhand is not the state behind this single-authority industrial approval reform.
• Option D is Incorrect because Odisha is not associated with this state legislation.

bihar_questions.qe: The Gangata forest section, which requires forest clearance for the widening of National Highway-333, is located in which wildlife sanctuary of Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग-333 के चौड़ीकरण के लिए भूमि हस्तांतरण से संबंधित गंगटा वन क्षेत्र बिहार के किस वन्यजीव अभयारण्य का हिस्सा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 10.5-km section of NH-333 passing through Gangata forest in Munger district requires forest land from the Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary.
• Option A is Incorrect because Valmiki Wildlife Sanctuary is situated in West Champaran district.
